annotations.note: After deductions (insurance, uniforms, etc.) Tom's first pay was $4.70, about $90 in today's money.
The first of several rumoured dates (later Oct. 13 and Oct. 28). The class actually graduated on Oct. 21, 1942.

quote.exact:
I think the Navy
is hard up for officers

annotations.note: He was right. In March 1941 the Navy had only about 18,000 officers; between Pearl Harbor and the end of 1944 it commissioned some 286,000 more, most of them reservists trained in a few months, like Tom.
